notes:
Faster page turning when you move through several pages quickly.

Turning a run of pages in a row could pause for a second and then jump to where you had got to. Two things were behind it. The tablet was drawing pages in the order they were asked for rather than putting the page you are actually looking at first, so the page on screen often waited behind pages you had already turned past. It could also draw the same page twice over.

Obbligato now also looks at how much free memory your tablet actually has and keeps as many pages ready as will comfortably fit, instead of using a fixed amount chosen for one particular tablet. On a tablet with memory to spare, more pages are ready before you reach them.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
